text:
Lucas: tiny life update — got promoted to Staff SWE and also celebrating our 3-year anniversary this weekend. thinking a micro office shindig Tues 4:30pm in the lobby? quick snacks, no pressure. who can make it?
Tara: WHOA congrats on both!! :tada: 4:30 works for me. i'll bring a little banner.
Mei: congrats Lucas!! can we do mini cupcakes? i can bring a batch (incl gf).
Sam: double win! i'll bring sparkling water + a small cheese plate. also can we do a tiny toast (1-2min)?
Lucas: love it. short toast would be lovely but optional — mostly want to steal a moment to say thanks.
Priya: count me in. do you want a card? i can pick one up and drop at reception.
Jose: :thumbsup: i'll bring napkins + biodegradable plates. also vote for cupcakes over cake — easier.
Anya: yay congrats Lucas!! i'll be remote but can pop on for the toast for ~5 mins. please add a video link.
Sam: quick form for snacks + contributions: https://forms.gle/lucas-shindig (short).
Lucas: thanks all. remote link is fine — Sam, can you add one to the invite?
pyro-bot: Proposed event: "Lucas: staff promo + 3yr anniversary" Tue 4:30 PM — Lobby. React with :thumbsup: to RSVP.
Tara: adding a tiny playlist too. thematic choices: "indie happy hour" or "soft 2000s pop"?
Mei: indie happy hour please.
Jose: indie happy hour + cupcakes it is.
Priya: dropping a quick congratulations GIF in the thread :confetti_ball: :sparkles:
Sam: created calendar invite and added Zoom link (zoom.us/j/246800) — will send to team@redwood.com.
Anya: will join live for the toast. congrats again Lucas!!
Lucas: you all are the best. no gifts please, just your vibes. see you Tuesday :)
Tara: see you! i'll bring mini succulents as a silly desk token (optional).
Mei: gf cupcakes confirmed. Sam: can you grab one dairy-free option too?
Sam: yep will pick up dairy-free minis.
pyro-bot: Event created: "Lucas: staff promo + 3yr anniversary" Tue 4:30 PM — Lobby. Invites sent to team@redwood.com
Jose: logging RSVP now. sending congrats gifs in thread.
Anya: recorded a 20s clip and DM'd Lucas. congrats again!!!
_meta: watercooler slack thread: promotion + personal anniversary, micro celebration planning, RSVP link and bot-created event
